messages:
sre-oncall: :rotating_light: Observed sustained NIC errors on a subset of GPU nodes in us-west-2b. Attach ops failing for some pods, tail latency rising ~350ms on generation. Starting targeted offload of non-critical pools now.
maya: Which pools are non-critical? can we avoid customer-facing routes?
liam: seeing 12% attach_failures in metrics for gw-gpu-2b pool since 21:02 UTC. Also a couple of kernel NIC resets in node logs.
kevin: priority: 1) avoid impacting prod-llm, 2) drain batch/ingest jobs first, 3) shift traffic to nearby healthy nodes/regions if needed. Agree to kick low-priority drains.
sre-oncall: draining nodes with nic_err > 5 in last 5m. Command: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-2b-07 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpu-node-2b-07`
ana: (typo) ana: Can we enable regional fallback routing for session tokens from prod-llm? We should avoid cross-region cold starts though.
maya: Let's flip routing policy for the next 30m to prefer west-2a then fallback to east-1. Patch below:
```
# redwood-routing patch
- match: region==us-west-2b
  allow_fallback: false
+ match: region==us-west-2b
  allow_fallback: true
  fallback_priority: [us-west-2a, us-east-1]
```
liam: Applying the routing patch to canary route only: `kubectl apply -f routing-canary.yaml` — doing now.
sre-oncall: deploy-bot: started drain on gpu-node-2b-07, 2b-09 and 2b-11. ETA 7-10m to be safe (KV caches will be rehydrated).
deploy-bot: :gear: drain job queued (id: 8492). Notifying autoscaler.
kevin: autoscaler: please hold scale-in on west-2b pools until drains complete. We don't want premature terminations. Also warm up a few replacement nodes in west-2a to take load: `scale pool gw-gpu-2a +3 warm=true`
ana: Will start migrating low-priority batch jobs to spot pools in east-1. Migration plan: mark workloads with label `priority=low` and `affinity: east-1-spot` then `kubectl rollout restart`.
maya: note on cost/capacity tradeoff: moving to east-1 spot reduces cost but may increase preemption risk. We've told support teams to expect slight increase in 503s on long-poll endpoints for 10-20m while caches refill.
liam: Monitoring: generation-99p latency returning to baseline for most keys after route flip, attach_failures for gw-gpu-2b down to 3% and trending.
sre-oncall: plan update: finish drains, validate KV cache hit-rate > 80% on fallback pools, then slowly re-enable direct routing for low-risk tokens. Fingers crossed for warmback in ~25m. :white_check_mark:
kevin: after stabilizing, we should run a postmortem checklist: NIC error correlation, firmware/driver roll, and whether to reprioritize reserved vs spot capacity for this AZ. I'll own follow-up.
ana: FYI I'll notify customer-facing channels that we've shifted workloads and are monitoring; no action required from customers.
liam: last check: attach_failures at 1.1%, tail latency ~95ms — closing escalation unless new regressions appear.
sre-oncall: marking thread for follow-up doc. Thanks everyone.
